topic: Field life visuals without regressing large-field performance
currentUserGoal: Make late/deep-game fields feel more visually engaging while keeping the optimized large-field performance intact.
changesMade: Added a budgeted field-life visual pass in GameScene that runs roughly once per second and only samples already-visible tile keys.
The pass favors grown rare, dewy, lush, fertile, and moist tiles, then emits tiny bursts plus a very small number of tracked transient spark objects.
Added an occasional lightweight meadow-current sweep for large fields, gated by effect quality, object pressure, board render idleness, and board scale.
Added fieldFxObjects to perf stats and the perf overlay so this new visual layer can be watched during stress tests.
Added a combo landing pulse for manual and automation threshold combos so combo hits read better on large/batch-rendered fields.
All new transient objects are tracked through board transient cleanup, so pan/zoom/layout clears them immediately.

verificationRun.result: 1200 total tiles, 91 visible, viewport tile mode, 106 FPS, 0 frame spikes, fieldFxObjects 3.
1200 visible tiles, batch tile mode, 122 FPS, 0 frame spikes, fieldFxObjects 3 after lowering tiny-scale gates.

Completed. visibleTiles stayed 1200 in batch phases; layoutPasses 0; redraws 0; redrawQueued drained from 32 at idle to 0; maxFrameDeltaMs max 14; frameSpikes 0; displayObjects max 502; activeTweens max 21 outside tap burst; hotspots did not show field:life as a pressure point.

knownIssues: The wide/batch screenshot confirms activity in perf stats, but the tiny whole-field scale still makes subtle effects inherently small. Future polish could add a slightly larger low-frequency board-level shimmer, but it should stay behind the same perf gates.
Deploy, push, and Mac sync were requested immediately after the local verification; see final assistant message for the exact commit/deploy/sync result.
nextRecommendedSteps: Play a normal late-game save and judge whether the field feels alive enough without the perf overlay.
After deployment, play a production late-game save and judge whether the field-life layer is noticeable enough without the perf overlay.
If more drama is needed, prefer rare milestone/biome-level moments over increasing per-second ambient object counts.
doNotRevert: Do not remove the large-field culling/batch rendering protections to add visual activity.
Do not replace the sampled visible-tile field-life pass with full-field scans or per-tile animation.
